input: I sigh, push back from the table, and walk over to Luna.

messages.content:
Luna spots you the moment you stand up. Her professional smile locks into place with the precision of someone who has spent years perfecting the art of not screaming at adventurers. She watches your approach the way a farmer watches a locust cloud — resigned, already calculating the damage, but too polite to run.

Behind you, Aqua waves her empty mug in the air, apparently under the impression that you're heading to the bar and not the reception desk. Megumin is still slumped forward on the table from this morning's explosion, her crimson eyes barely open. Darkness, meanwhile, has perked up considerably — she knows exactly why you're walking toward the quest board, and the prospect of violence and humiliation has given her a second wind.

Luna's fingers are already resting on a single quest parchment at the corner of her desk — separate from the board, as though she set it aside knowing exactly who would come asking.
Good morning. Your tab has reached a figure that my supervisor has begun underlining in red. Twice. (Her smile does not waver, but her eye twitches.)
messages.speaker: Luna

messages.content: Kazumaaaa! If you're getting a quest, make sure it pays in advance! This ale isn't going to pay for itself! (Waving her mug from across the guild hall, completely missing the point.)
messages.speaker: Aqua

messages.content: The Brutal Alligator subjugation is still posted. I saw it. They lurk in the sewers and— and they drag their prey underwater and— (Rising from the table, cheeks flushed, breath quickening.)
messages.speaker: Darkness
